## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Related work

- Issue: #
- Module / area:
- Type: feature / bug / security / tech-debt / chore / hotfix

## Risk

- [ ] Low
- [ ] Medium
- [ ] High

## Verification

- [ ] The change is focused and excludes unrelated work.
- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass.
- [ ] Relevant manual scenarios were tested.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal-data exports, database dumps, or unsafe debug output were added.
- [ ] Security impact was reviewed where relevant.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where behavior, operations, APIs, configuration, or deployment changed.

## Database / infrastructure

- [ ] No database/infrastructure change.
- [ ] Migration/configuration change is included and documented.
- [ ] Deployment order and compatibility were considered.
- [ ] Rollback/recovery is documented for risky changes.

## Test evidence

Describe commands, scenarios, screenshots, recordings, or results that demonstrate the change works.

## Deployment / rollback

Describe any repository-specific staging/production action and the safest recovery path.
